_comment: Written by build-odds-history.mjs from data/odds-snapshot.json: every committed copy git can see plus the working-tree one. Rows are merged across runs and never removed or rewritten. One row per matchup per snapshot; pA is the chance manager a beats manager b as the site priced it at that moment. teams holds each finalized week's playoff and title chances (0..1) per team, from the newest snapshot read after that week went final; a newer reading of the same week replaces that week's team rows.
